balls.text: middle stump knocked back! Yorker on middle. DK goes across to the off side to play a sweep fine. But he misses, and the zing bails have lit up. Knight Riders finish on 165 for 7
through the legs as Arshdeep bowls a beautiful yorker outside leg. Goes through Narine's legs, but can't stop them from pinching the bye.
good length on middle. Stays on the back foot and drags a pull to deep midwicket. Just one though, despite the misfield
full outside off stump. Paddles a sweep to deep backward square
full outside off. Throws his bat at this and slaps a cut through the infield. Hooda is in the deep
yorker length on leg. Swipes it behind square to fine leg
fullish outside off. Slapped back to Shami. He blocks, and ends with an economy of under 6!
full toss, low on middle. Shoveled to deep midwicket, for two
direct hit! Shami with the throw. Yorker outside off. Seifert tried to play a reverse ramp. Struck on his boots, tried to take a single, and Shami gets it pinpoint

wild heave and Seifer can't connect. Good length ball on off and the slower ball bounces over the stumps. Seifert misses, but they start running before the ball can get to the keeper. Rahul misses the direct hit, the ball rolls to Shami, and then Shami tries to do a direct hit as well. Misses, gives them the extra run
full, but just outside leg stump. No shot offered, and wide taken
yorker attempted. On leg stump, and clipped to deep backward square leg for a single
struck to mid off for one
full outside off and he smacks a drive to the fielder in the deep. Just a one. Expensive from Arshdeep, but he did dismiss Rana
full just outside leg. DK misses the flick, and it hits the front leg. Ball rolls away to point as they pinch a run. Appeal turned down and they don't review. This definitely pitched outside leg

six? No! Slower ball. Length delivery angling in, and he looks to pull over deep midwicket. Mistimed, in the air, Mayank in the deep reverse cups the catch on the boundary line. A little better timing and that was another six. For now, a useful cameo ends
smartly done! Full on off stump. He walks across, opens up the leg side, and then paddles this overpitched ball over short fine leg for four more!
full outside off. Skips down the ground at drives in front of square. Man at deep point - Hooda - has to run around the boundary line to dive and stop the four
shot of the evening! Full outside off. Rana moves towards the off side and then lifts a drive over cover. Played with ease, and struck it exactly where he wanted it to go
yorker length around leg stump. Backs away and toe-ends a shot to cover point. Ellis 0/46 tonight
picks the slower ball early! Full on off and middle. But Rana comes down the ground, adjusts to make up for the change of pace, and then swats a shot over Ellis' head for six. That went for 94m
good length just outside off. Opens the bat's face and taps it to cover point
yorker length on middle, around the stump. Backs away and drives to mid off's right
good length outside off. Stays on the back foot and punches to deep point
slower ball, length ball. He slaps a cut, and its rolling behind square. Fielder in the deep runs around to intercept
overpitched outside off. Runs it down to third man for one. Terrific Shami over
plumb! Overpitched on leg stump. Morgan moves to the off side to flick behind square. He misses, hits the boot, and that's out!
full just outside off. Smacks this onto the deck, and the ball rolls past the stumps to long off. Gets off the mark with a double
full and wide outside off. Moves to the off side and checks a drive through the off side to the man in the deep
good length on off. Guided to backward point. Rana wants one, Morgan doesn't. Rana has to get back
full outside off. Leans into a drive but the ball goes past the edge. Rahul collects. Rana's strike-rate is just over 100
full on middle. Turning across. Nudged away to midwicket for a single
full on off. Late cut to short third man. Rana wants one, but Morgan says no. Rana has to turn and return

straight to the fielder! Full outside off. Turning further away. Iyer moves to the off side to drag a slog sweep over deep midwicket. But it's been hit flat, and another catch added to Hooda's tally. Out after another top innings
good length outside off. Turning further away. Misses the cut
full on middle. Looks to push it straight back. But leading edge takes it over the non-striker's head! Bishnoi turns and chases
welcomed with the reverse sweep! Full on middle, and expected the googly would turn to off. Turns around and commits wholly to the reverse sweep. Played over backward point
fullish outside off. Moving away, and he dabs a late cut to third man for one
another slower ball. Full outside off, and he drives to long off for a single
slower ball, very wide outside off. Past the tramlines, and the umpire ends up giving a wide
full and wide outside off. Just inside the tramlines as Iyer fails to connect with the yorker. Appeal for caught behind, turned down
nobody moves! In the slot, just outside off. Iyer simply blasts a drive past cover for a one-bounce four! Hit flat, and the man in the deep was a mere spectator
soft! There's power and there's precision too. This is full, on off, but the slower ball too. Iyer walks across to the off side, and then paddles one gently over short fine leg for four
full and wide. Looks to drive but the ball goes past the edge. Hits the deck and through to Rahul

full on middle and leg. Comes down the wicket and absolutely drills it straight back. In the air, but Allen can't take the low catch on the followthrough. Hits the palm and the ball goes to ground. But Allen may have twisted his ankle while trying to get behind the ball
is he teeing off?! Full on middle and leg. He goes down on one knee and clubs a slog sweep over deep midwicket. Team hundred breached in style
full on leg. Tap and run as the ball rolls away to deep midwicket
full and wide outside off. Throws his hands at it and slaps the ball to extra cover
full outside leg. Looks to sweep. Misses, hits the pad and rolls away to short fine leg. LBW appeal turned down
full ball on leg from around the stumps. Flicked to deep midwicket and that's his second IPL fifty, gets there in 39 balls. Applause from the dugout
half-tracker on off. Cuts it with the spin through to deep point
good length on off. Skidding across, and he sticks the bat out to pay a late cut to short third man
good length on off. Turning further away. Flat-bats a shot down the ground to long off
Hooda gets that and the partnership ends. Bishnoi the partnership breaker as this googly is mistimed in the air. Tripathi tried to slog sweep, and it went aerial to long on
full outside off. Hammers a front foot drive to long off for just one
length ball skidding into middle and leg. Muscled to long on for a single
slower ball. Full outside off. This was a back-of-the-hand delivery. Bunted past the bowler to mid off
full toss, outside off. Tripathi punishes this by slapping it past cover point's right for four more!
length ball on leg stump. Iyer is quick to hammer a whippy shot off his hips to deep backward square leg
full on off. Muscles a dragged shot to deep midwicket for just one. He was looking to tee off this ball
full outside off. Drives but with the bat's face open. Sliced behind point to the boundary there
full outside off. Looks to drive straight past the non-striker but it takes an edge to point. Bishnoi takes a shy at the stumps, but he misses the direct hit. Tripathi was gone if that hit
very full on middle, and swung away to long-on
wrong 'un! Short of a length on off, and sharp turn into him. Pulled to deep square leg, with the ball keeping low too
and another one to the fielder at cover. Full and outside off, and driven with the full face of the bat
skips down to this really full outside off, and drills that to the man at cover
flights this up really well and quick at 102kph on middle and off. Pushed to long-on after leaning forward
short and just outside off, cut away to short third man off the top edge
full again on his pads, and rams that all along the ground to deep midwicket
flicks this full ball on leg to fine leg for a quick single
just short of short third man! He goes flashing at this shortish ball outside off, as the ball takes his outside edge and flies toward the fielder instead
dances down to this pretty full ball on middle, and clips that to deep midwicket
really full on middle, and he pushes that forward to long-off
cracks that sweep! That makes a pleasing sound off the bat. Goes down on his back knee to this full ball on middle and off, and clears the rope with excellent timing and roll of the wrists
again goes short and outside off. Turning away from him, as Iyer cuts to deep point, where the man runs to his right and slides to stop the ball
bisects short third man and point. He opens his bat face to tickle that shortish and wide of off again, and plays that late to find the gap
short of a length and wide of off, finds point with his cut away from his body
googly now. Good length outside off, and Tripathi clips toward with the turn into him, as Bishnoi gives the chase
tosses it up really full on his pads, as Iyer clips that to deep midwicket
beats him outside off. Short of a length outside off, which turns away a touch
fuller on middle, and flicked to deep midwicket
good length ball outside off, and pushed back to the bowler, who dives to his left to stop that
finds the gap between long-on and deep midwicket! Allen goes short and just outside off, as Iyer goes deep in his crease to pull that away for a four
lofts this full ball on middle to long-on with a couple of bounces. Fifty up for Knight Riders
drives this full ball on off right to the man at cover as he plays with the full face of the bat
goes full on middle, as Iyer pushes it to long-on
good stop by Allen, as he runs to his left and slides at deep square leg. Tripathi flicks this full ball on his pads aerially, and completes two
Ellis gets his right hand out, as Iyer drives this full ball just outside off between the bowler and the stumps. Quick single taken toward mid-on
another good length ball on middle, but this time finds mid-on with his punch
clipped between midwicket and mid-on now! Another change of pace ball from Ellis, as he goes on a good length on middle. Iyer is deep in his crease, and uses his wrists to time that away well

mid-off dives to his right, as the ball slides below him. Bishnoi the man there. Ellis bowls the slower ball from back of the hand, and goes full just outside off. Iyer presents the full face of the bat to drive, and grabs full marks
good length ball on middle, and clipped to the man at midwicket

good stop by the man at short fine leg by sticking out his left hand and limit that to a single. Iyer moves around his back leg to try and distract the bowler, who goes full on his pads. Again clipped behind the wicket, but this one for a single only
good length ball on middle, and darting back in. Clipped toward square leg for another rapid run
dabs this fullish ball wide of off to short third man with a flat bat, and sets off for a single. Quick run completed
beats short fine leg for four! Arshdeep goes full on his pads, with the ball angling in again. And Iyer just has to get a bit of bat to flick that to the right of the man inside the circle
opens his bat face a touch to this full delivery outside off, but finds the man at point this time
clips this full ball on middle right to the man at straightish midwicket
pulled over mid-on! Shami goes short and just outside off on this occasion, as Tripathi hangs back deep in his crease to swing that away forcefully and after making good use of his bottom hand
goes across off, and looks to scoop this full ball wide of off. But Shami sees him moving early, and follows him, as Tripathi misses his shot, with the ball striking his body instead
flashed to third man on the bounce! Makes room to this very full ball just outside off, and goes down on his back knee to lift that away from his body
comes down after making room to this full ball just outside off. Slashed to mid-on for a rapid single
past his outside edge! Sharp, good length outside off, with an upright seam. Tripathi looks to poke at that 139kph ball, but is beaten, with the ball also getting good bounce
good length ball on middle, and almost cramping up for him with that movement into Iyer. Clipped to square leg for a single without much foot movement and from deep in his crease
inside edge toward deep square leg. Looks to drive this full ball on middle, but not where we wanted. Fine leg runs across to this left to stop that

beaten this time! Arshdeep goes on a good length on leg, and gets the ball to dart back into the batter, as Tripathi dances down and makes room. Nowhere in control of that ball, as it sneaks between him and the leg stump
opens the bat face to this full delivery on off which angles in. Beats point to his left, and gobbles up two
makes a touch of room and walks down a step, as Arshdeep bowls near yorker length on middle. Dug out toward point
another wide. Arshdeep goes full and outside leg, as this one again keeps angling down for wide again. KL Rahul not happy with that

crashes into his stumps! A lovely left-armer's dismissal. Full delivery  on off, with a faint movement into the batter, who is early into his drive. The ball takes a little inside edge again - as Gill had got against Shami last over - as it strikes middle and off to leave Knight Riders one down early. Good seam position from Arshdeep too, and an early wicket for him
skips down again, but this time Arshdeep bowls full on leg. The ball keeps angling down leg, as Rahul dives to his left to stop that. Wide called
beaten first ball! Arshdeep goes pretty full and just outside off and in the channel. Gill leans forward to drive with an angled bat, but the ball passes his outside edge
inside edge to short fine leg's left. Shami goes fuller and just outside off, as Gill drives forward but is beaten by the hint of movement into him
between cover and mid-off! This time Gill makes room and dances down to this short of a length ball outside off, and stretches out to crash that powerfully with a horizontal bat
good delivery outside off. Pitches it on a good length around fifth stump, and gets that to move away with an upright seam, as Gill leaves it alone
this is a good length ball on middle, as his bat face closes while trying to turn that toward square leg for a single
goes short of a length, and just outside off. Iyer rides the bounce, and pushes it back to the bowler from close to his body
bowls short and wide first ball, with the ball angling away. Gill cuts away from his body, as Mayank at cover dives to his right and gets a hand to stop a couple
second boundary in the over! Allen tosses it up, and bowls full and wide of off. Iyer reaches out for it to drive using his wrists, and beats mid-off to his right. Great start for Knight Riders
pretty full ball on off, and punched to long-off, who is one of the two men out for the right-hander
fuller on off, and clipped to long-on now
and again. Good length on middle, and turning away a touch. Driven to mid-off
full and on off, pushed toward mid-off
Clipped to deep square leg for four first ball. Allen tosses it up and bowls really full on middle, as deep midwicket runs in to his left and dives, but can't save the four

caught? Nope, dropped...and six! Length ball outside off. Shahrukh looks to smack a six over deep midwicket. But it's not going all the way! Tripathi runs around to take a catch, but the ball pops out of his hand and goes over the line! Zinta celebrates, KL Rahul breaths a sigh of relief and Punjab Kings win by five wickets

holes out to long off! Good length outside off. Rahul backs away to make room. Clubs it over the bowler, but only to Mavi at long off! Preity Zinta facepalms. Is this another familiar Kings choke? Rahul walks back for a 55-ball 67
slower ball. Full outside off. Looks for a glory slog to the leg side. Toe-ends it past the diving keeper's right for a single
slower ball. Waist high full toss. Slapped over point, and that means Punjab Kings need five in six balls
yorker attempted. Dug back, past Mavi's right. Long on runs around to keep it down to one
full toss just outside off. Punched down the ground to long on for a single

that's a terrific catch! Full outside off. Rahul goes for the expansive leg-side swipe. Hit in the air, but the ball is dipping. Tripathi runs in from deep midwicket, dives full length forward, and takes the catch while his elbows graze against the floor. Tripathi says its out, but the umpires want to go upstairs. TV umpire asks the producers to rock and roll, to see if Tripathi took a clean catch. Did he get his fingers under the ball while taking the catch? Sure looks so, but the final call is with the umpire. TV umpire says "please take it nice and slow, frame by frame" as he decides on a verdict. Anil Dandekar asks for a few more angles. And then declares "ball has touched the ground"....NOT OUT! So close...but Rahul survives. The TV umpire concludes that the ball had hit the floor while Tripathi was in his catch motion.
slower ball. Overpitched but dipping in sharply. Looks to drag a slog sweep but misses. Through to DK
goes through! Low full toss outside off. Rahul looks to drive through the covers but it takes an edge and races past short third man's left
keeper misfields, and they pinch an extra run. Slower ball outside off. Soft edge as he misses the cut, but Karthik lets it go through as well. Short fine leg runs around to keep it down to just one
good length outside off. TRaps it to point, and Rahul tells Shahrukh to come across for the run
drilled for four. Short and wide, and Shahrukh smacks it square. Races along the carpet, and deep extra cover's dive is futile too!
slower ball, short on off. Drags a flat-batted shot to long on. On the bounce to Iyer
length ball angling into him, and confidently flicked fine. But fine leg is on the boundary line

falls between keeper and short fine leg! Full on off, and Rahul walks across to play a paddle over short fine leg. Mistimed, in the air. Karthik and short fine leg congregate to take a catch, but its gone just beyond DK
good length, outside off. Punched to point. Kings need 24 off 18

catch? six? catch? six! Short ball angling into him, and he's hooked that with ease! Iyer, the tall man on the boundary line, sticks one hand out, grabs it, tosses the ball up, but tumbles over the line trying to take the follow-up on the rebound
short and wide ball. Shahrukh reaches out and cuts it hard through point. Seifert runs around the boundary line but can't stop the second run

taken on the boundary line. Full ball on middle and leg. Hooda clears the front leg to drill a lofted shot over deep midwicket for six. But he mistimes the offcutter, and Tripathi slides along the ground in the deep to take the catch. Back leg very close to the boundary skirting, but replays show that the catch in clean
full on off stump. Flicked off his toes, and Iyer at deep backward square leg runs around the line to stop the four
slower ball. Full outside off, and he caresses a drive to Seifert at deep point. Just one though

Narine bowls out, and he has done the job by breaking the Markram-Rahul partnership. But its been an expensive evening for his very high standards. Full outside off, and driven to Morgan at short cover
good length on leg. And angling across. Pulls along the ground to wide long on for one
full outside off. Driven to extra cover on the boundary.

good length, wider outside off. Cut in front of square and that's been hit too well! Straight to Gill at deep extra cover. Markram can't believe how well he's hit that. The Kings fans in the VIP lounge can't believe that such a good shot has resulted in a wicket
full and wide outside off. Just over the tramlines though, according to the umpire
full on middle. Markram takes a big backswing, and then goes across the line to absolutely cream a big six over deep midwicket! 95m long
good length ball. But wide outside off. No shot offered
full on middle, and skidding into leg. Markram comes down the ground to hammer a big shot over midwicket. Misses, hits his pad
slower ball, full on middle. Comes down the ground and mistimes a shot to long on for one
good length on off and he drags a flick off his waist to deep backward square leg

flat six! Gets to fifty in style. Length ball on off. Slower ball too, and he picks the pace early. Waits, waits, and then drills a pull in front of square. A gentle raise of the bat, the Kings fans in the VIP lounge applaud his effort
good length on leg and angling down the leg side. Rahul looks to flick it fine behind square but can't get bat on ball
full on off. Takes the pace off slightly. Markram looks to club a slog to midwicket, but mistimes it instead. Ball rolls away to deep backward square leg
length ball on middle, and angling into leg as Markram backs away. Misses the swipe. Hits the pad, then pops up in the air, and then hits him on the top of his helmet!
sliced but falls between mid and mid off. Luck with Markram on this occasion. Good length ball that was not pulled perfectly
full outside leg. Angling into his pads, and he flicks it over midwicket to Tripathi in the deep. Six off the over and we take another time out
around the stumps again. Full on middle. Swept to deep midwicket, Nagarkoti with the quick work
drops just short of short third man! Looks to cut this length ball, but ends up getting a thick edge. Ball pops in the air but dips and drops sharply. Hits the ground before Rana can attempt the dive
full on middle. Goes deep in his crease and taps it to the gap at midwicket. Comfortably run for one
full just outside off. Comes down the ground and chips a shot over the non-striker to long on for one
full on middle. Turning into leg. Rahul goes deep and works it off his pad to square leg for a single
full and wide outside off. Smothers a drive to Morgan at cover
is that the release shot? Iyer concedes another six in his over. Full on off. In the slot and angling in, and Rahul simply whips an attacking shot off his pads to get it over midwicket
full on off. And a whippy shot over Rahul's head to long on for one
full and wide, almost on the tramlines. But Rahul walks across to the off side, and mistimes a straight drive. Rolls away to long on
full and wide outside off stump. Square drive to deep point for a single
full and wide outside off. Comes down the ground and mistimes a slog to deep midwicket
full on off. Worked off the pads to midwicket for a single
low full toss angling into leg stump. Drilled past midwicket to wide long on again
full outside off. Markram moves to the leg side and swipes a shot inside out through to wide long off. Mavi has to put in the hard yards
full on middle, and defended off the back foot to midwicket
fullish outside off. Turning into off. Flat-batted down the ground to long on for a single

half-tracker on leg. Turning into him further. Pulled along the ground to wide long on. Rahul Tripathi runs around from deep midwicket, slides, and stops the ball from going for four. The ball hit Tripathi on the face as he tried to field

full on off and turning in. Nudged to midwicket. Narine runs around to intercept, but misfields! Could've put pressure with a clean throw and get a run out. Wasn't to be. Chakravarthy finishes with 2/24
full outside off. Driven down the ground to long off's left for a single
sliced to deep backward point! Chakravarthy gets the breakthrough. Full outside off. turning away further. Nicky P looks to smack it over cover, but the shot is not in control. Mavi gets under it...
full toss, dipping on middle, and Pooran smacks it to wide long on for six! Muscles it to the leg side and gets it just beyond the boundary line
tossed up, overpitched so ends up as a full toss.  Drilled to long off down the ground for a single
length ball on off. Sliding across. Cut square to the fielder in the deep
full ball, and straighter on off. Nudged back to the bowler
full delivery and just outside off. Tapped to cover with the open face of the bat
shortish in length on leg, and turning in. Clipped to long-on after clearing his front leg
full delivery on off, and pushed to over
full on off again, and dabbed toward dee point with the open face of the bat
dropped at cover! This time it is Tripathi. He looks to take his high-ish on his left, but the ball pops out of the fielder's hands, as Pooran lofts that full ball outside off
low full-toss on off, and he drives down to long-off with the full face of the bat

this time nabbed by Morgan at cover! Again Mayank tries to use his bottom hand to loft that full delivery outside off and go inside out, but doesn't get it up and beyond the fielder there. He is furious with himself, but he walks back after a good innings
good length ball on off, and clipped to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
pushes this full ball on off to long-on, while closing the bat face

on the bounce to long-off, who has to scamper to his right to stop three runs! Southee the man there. Rahul sees that in the slot outside off, and sends that bang using his bottom hand. Rahul almost stood still after hitting that, perhaps assuming it would be a four
drilled through the covers! Comes down to this full ball wide of off, and presents the horizontal bat to beat cover to his right
clears the extra cover fence! Full-toss and a touch wide of off, as he leans into the drive slightly away from his body to send that high and far
high full-toss, and that lands beyond the pitch as Mayank looks to ramp that and misses. An above-waist no-ball called
slower ball, and short of a length outside off. The ball comes into him, as Rahul pulls to deep midwicket
good length ball on off, and he turns that around to fine leg with the closed face of the bat
another ball with a change of pace. Short and wide of off, and he pulls to long-on after waiting for the ball to come
leans into the drive, as he plays at this good length ball outside off to deep point. A rapid two is gobbled
starts with a slower ball. Full delivery outside off, and pushed back to the bowler with the closed face of the bat
plays that one like a half-volley, and drives that full ball outside off to deep point
leading edge! Turns away a touch after pitching on a fullish length on middle, as he clips but the ball lands at cover
good length on middle, and he pulls with the turn into him. The ball takes his pad, and trickles over for a leg-bye
tossed up, and really full on off. Nudged to long-on
inside edge, as he goes pushing at that full ball on off, which turns in sharply. A single grabbed, as the bowler runs across to his right to stop that
good length delivery on middle, and clipped toward deep midwicket from deep in his crease

good length ball on middle, and clipped toward long-on. Narine gives the chase across to his right, and hits the stumps with a direct hit at the bowler's end. The umpire goes upstairs to confirm, as replays indicate it was rather Morgan's right elbow that flicked the bails
good length ball on middle and turning away. Driven to long-on
just clears point over his head! Dances down to this full ball on off, as the bat turns in his hands while trying to loft that inside out
full ball on middle, and flicked toward midwicket for a single

he sends that milessss into the night sky, and just clears the rope behind the bowler! Again uses his bottom hand to loft that full ball on middle, and gets the result. Southee at long-on thought he was in business, but lets that thought go in the end
good length ball on off, and he presents the full face of the bat to drive that to long-on
short of a length on middle, and another one that turns into the batter. Clipped to the man at midwicket for a quick single
bowls on a good length on off, as this one spins back in. Pulled to deep square leg
fuller on off, and slashed to point with a flat bat
good length ball on off, and coming into him again. Pushed to cover with the full face of the bat
turns a touch into him, as this is short of a length outside off. Finds cover-point with his cut
good length ball on off, and nudged toward fine leg

makes room, and slams over cover! This is short of a length outside off, and Mayank backing away means he has all the space to hammer that with a free swing of the arms for four. An over that cost just a single all this while ends with a boundary
pushes that right to the man at cover. Good length ball and a touch outside off, as Mayank plays with the horizontal bat

goes for that loft inside out, but is beaten! The ball is full and right in the slot outside off too, but Mayank plays without much foot movement there, and is beaten on the outside edge with the ball angling away
opens the bat face to dab that late to third man, with Mavi going fullish and a touch wide of off
much fuller on off, and shaping in. Clipped to the man at midwicket
another diving stop by Morgan at cover! Rahul goes driving at the good length ball just outside off, and opens the bat face too. But again Morgan dives to his left, and saves a certain four
pushes the batter back with a good length ball just outside off. Pushed back to the bowler
fired over mid-off! That was in the slot for him to clear his front leg, and wait for the ball to move a touch away from him from the full length on off. Just an extension of the arms, and six!
gets this drive off the inside edge toward mid-on, as he goes flashing to another full delivery outside off

driven between the bowler and the stumps! Presents the full face of the bat to this full ball on off, and finds the little gap there, with Southee stretching out to his right but failing to get a hand
finds cover as he leans into this drive, with the ball again in the fullish length just outside off
opens the bat face, and runs that down late to third man, as Southee goes full and a touch wide of off
rapid run gobbled. Good length ball outside off with movement into him, and pushed to mid-on

that typical wrists of Mayank! And uses his bottom hand too to slice that high over the bowler's head, as the ball is full on off while angling in. The bat turns in his hand, while the ball trickles to the rope after dropping just short
back of a length, and a bit wide of off. Dabbed to point with this one moving away from him
another one that darts back in. Good length on off, and ends up on leg stump, as the ball takes his pad to trickle to the on side
good length ball just outside off, with the ball angling in sharply. Pushed to point with the movement into him
excellent stop by Morgan at cover! Dives to his left, and stops a certain four. Rahul drives at this length ball outside off with the full face of the bat, but Morgan makes a fine save while diving
this one comes back in, and Mayank is beaten! Fullish length in the channel outside off, as the ball angles in between Mayank's bat and the stumps as the batter tries to push at that
drills this between cover and mid-off! Finds the gap this time, as Southee pitches it up on a full length outside off, and Mayank again drives with the full face of the bat
good length ball just outside off. Cuts this toward third man with the movement away from him
guides this fullish ball outside off to third man with the open face of the bat

dropped by Morgan at cover! As if his lack of runs wasn't enough, he now drops a simple catch. That was hit a bit forcefully too, but was still takeable. Full length ball and in the driving length outside off, as Mayank presents the full face of the bat to that
gets an outside edge as he tries to drive this full delivery a touch wide of off. The ball moves away from Rahul, and a single down to third man
